note: Re-judged 2026-10-19 (independent auditor). Section 7.16: "An UPDATE message with a malformed ATTR_SET attribute SHALL be handled using the approach of "treat as withdraw"." TestRFC7606AttrSetMalformedInnerAttributes: The only change to this unit since the last judgement (ca4eae70a0) is the new sixth argument of ValidateUpdateRFC7606AddPath, passed as false (no capability 77), which skips the draft-ietf-idr-linklocal-capability Section 6 branch; no input byte or assertion changed, and the unit passes at HEAD. Its cases still assert exact TreatAsWithdraw with AttrCode 128 for a 2-octet inner AGGREGATOR, an inner ORIGIN flag conflict and an inner NEXT_HOP framing overrun, and exact None for the 4-octet AGGREGATOR, correct ORIGIN, 4-octet AS_PATH (an AS_SEQUENCE, so the new RFC 9774 scan does not fire), unknown optional and framed NEXT_HOP, under both outer ASN widths. Other carriers unchanged. Observation outside this row: inner attributes are judged through validateAttribute, so an AS_SET inside an ATTR_SET's inner AS_PATH now makes the ATTR_SET malformed by way of RFC 9774; no test pins that reading either way. The negative's revert record is unit-changed and owes re-recording.
